ceo_directive: P0 implement FDA PCLC metrics as executable module. P1 correct ISO 7197 mapping. P2 VIEshunt comparison matrix. P3 upgrade bench with UK Shunt Lab. P4 add physiological disturbances. P5 build automatic test report generator.
headline: Evidence Engine upgraded from 22/47 to 35/47 executable requirements. FDA PCLC metrics module implemented (7 metrics: rise time, settling time, overshoot, steady-state error, time in target, median PE, wobble) with artifact check pipeline. ISO 7197 corrected to PARTIAL APPLICABILITY (active system, not non-active). VIEshunt comparison matrix created (12 dimensions: P-01 has algorithm, VIEshunt has hardware). 5 physiological disturbances added (posture, cough, respiratory, production rate, distal pressure). Automated test report generator designed (14-section FDA/NASA-grade report).

P0_fda_pclc_metrics.artifact_check: Added per FDA warning: raw data → artifact check → metrics → evidence record. Checks for NaN/Inf, implausible values, impossible jumps.
P0_fda_pclc_metrics.tested_on: 5 scenarios (none, noise_3x, sensor_dropout, fast_occlusion, multi_failure). multi_failure correctly flagged as artifact (ICP >100 mmHg).

P1_iso_7197_correction.correction: ISO 7197:2024 is for NON-ACTIVE shunts. P-01 is ACTIVE. Classified as REFERENCE/PARTIAL APPLICABILITY. 3 requirements APPLY (hydraulic resistance, reflux, mechanical), 2 PARTIALLY APPLY (pressure-flow, opening/closing — measured both statically and dynamically), 1 DOES NOT APPLY (sterile single-use — buyer's responsibility).

P2_vieshunt_comparison.key_finding: VIEshunt has the HARDWARE (micro-pump, flow meter, IMU, wireless, HIL test, animal pilot). P-01 has the ALGORITHM (bounded-rate conductance control + multi-segment redistribution + sensor-health fallback). P-01 is NOT competing with VIEshunt on hardware — P-01 is a CONTROL ALGORITHM that could be applied to any intelligent shunt hardware including VIEshunt-class systems.
P2_vieshunt_comparison.biggest_gap: VIEshunt has physical evidence (24h HIL test, animal pilot). P-01 has computational evidence only. Closing this gap is #1 priority.

P4_physiological_disturbances.extended_attack_matrix: 9 controller attacks + 5 physiological disturbances = 14 total attack modes

P5_test_report_generator.implements: NASA SE (config control, anomaly, corrective action) + FDA bench testing (recommended content and format)

P3_bench_upgrade.status: DEFINED — UK Shunt Lab elements identified
P3_bench_upgrade.integration: These upgrades are captured in the physiological disturbances (P4) and the BOM will be updated when bench is built

evidence_engine_progress.note: 13 requirements completed in R291 (FDA metrics 3, ISO correction 1, VIEshunt 2, physiological 3, report generator 2, bench upgrade 2). 12 remaining are mostly physical-bench-dependent (can't complete until bench is built).
